name: nexora-intelligence
description: Bangladesh-first AI commerce intelligence operating system

scripts.format:api: poetry --directory apps/api run black . && poetry --directory apps/api run ruff check . --fix
scripts.format:api:check: poetry --directory apps/api run black --check . && poetry --directory apps/api run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck:api: poetry --directory apps/api run mypy app main.py
scripts.validate:api: pnpm run format:api:check && pnpm run typecheck:api && pnpm run test:api
scripts.validate: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run validate:api
